name: std::atomic_ref<T>::notify_all
intro:
Performs atomic notifying operations.

Unblocks all threads blocked in atomic waiting operations (i.e. wait()) on *ptr, if there are any; otherwise does nothing.
This overload participates in overload resolution only if std::is_const_v<T> is false.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: This form of change-detection is often more efficient than simple polling or pure spinlocks.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Use aligned integer storage; atomically change 0 to 5, then wait for a worker to store 7.
